issue_context.title: Basic integration Airflow and connexion
issue_context.body:
**Description**

We must provide basic integration of Airflow with connexion. This should contain a foundation for other works. For now, it can return empty objects on any request. Each endpoint should be publicly available.

More information about REST API:
https://github.com/apache/airflow/issues/8107

**Use case / motivation**

Creating a foundation for other work.

**Related Issues**

N/A

review_comments: This class code is repeated in each test file. Also we have `http_client` fixture which also provides the app 😸

Yes. There are so many repetitions in this code because it is a skeleton. I hope that soon this code will be more different. I didn't want to introduce 3-level inheritance here, because it would complicate the tests excessively. This is ok if the code is repeated because it makes the code much simpler and less complex. Now each test file is not dependent on anything and each person can work independently.
Here is an article about it: https://testing.googleblog.com/2019/12/testing-on-toilet-tests-too-dry-make.html
And what about the fixture? Should it stay or not?
